comparison.objective: Feed and hand over a cable through a grommet, versus commission an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable threading and cross-panel handover differ from rigid fastener engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct cable routing and band position without fixture damage; no adjustment lock or repeated dynamic-stop validation.
comparison.reason: Different physical system and tested ability.
